# NexusPilot Fleet Documentation

> Distributed Multi-Agent Swarm Orchestrator, Git Worktree Multiplexer & DAG Pipeline Engine for AI Coding Agents.

## Overview
NexusPilot Fleet is an open-source MCP suite and Google Antigravity plugin providing:
1. DAG Pipeline Engine for decomposing massive refactorings into parallel tasks.
2. Zero-collision git worktree multiplexing (.fleet/worktrees/worker-<id>).
3. Two-Key Consensus Protocol (Author -> Reviewer -> Verifier).
4. Shared Blackboard and inter-agent SQLite event bus (.fleet/fleet_bus.db).

## Key Links
- GitHub: https://github.com/nishantshaligram/nexus-pilot-fleet
- MCP Tools Catalog: https://nishantshaligram.github.io/nexus-pilot-fleet/reference/mcp-tools
- Quickstart Guide: https://nishantshaligram.github.io/nexus-pilot-fleet/getting-started/quickstart

## MCP Tools Reference
- `create_mission(goal, base_branch)`: Initializes mission and provisions squad.
- `decompose_goal(mission_id, goal)`: Breaks mission into topologically sorted DAG nodes.
- `dispatch_ready_tasks(mission_id)`: Provisions worktrees and dispatches ready tasks.
- `submit_task_for_review(task_id, worker_id, summary)`: Submits draft for review.
- `approve_review_key1(task_id, reviewer_id, notes)`: Grants Key 1 (Architecture).
- `verify_tests_key2(task_id, verifier_id, test_summary)`: Grants Key 2 (Tests).
- `merge_task_worktree(mission_id, task_id)`: Merges verified branch and cleans worktree.
- `broadcast_to_blackboard(mission_id, topic, content)`: Publishes shared fact.
- `query_blackboard(mission_id, topic)`: Queries shared blackboard facts.
